scripts.dev:backend: bash scripts/run-env.sh backend/.env -- bash -lc 'cd backend && PY=${PYTHON_BIN:-}; if [ -z "$PY" ]; then if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then PY=.venv/bin/python; elif command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then PY=python3; else PY=python; fi; fi; exec "$PY" -m uvicorn main:asgi_app --host 127.0.0.1 --port ${BACKEND_PORT:-8006} --reload'
